capabilities: Edit equations visually by clicking fractions, roots, integrals, matrices and systems
Switch between visual, LaTeX and hybrid editing modes
Plot functions, polar curves, 3D surfaces and complex points
Build 3D geometry solids and spatial intersection scenes
Convert units and look up periodic table elements
disambiguation: Not a math solver; it formats notation and renders numerical graphs without symbolically solving equations.
extras: Runs fully offline with no AI, cloud accounts or subscriptions; requires Obsidian 1.14.4+ on desktop; chemistry and unit notation need host mhchem support when exported outside Obsidian.
motivation: I built Visual Math so you can write math, chemistry, and physics notes in Obsidian without typing raw LaTeX by hand every time.
problem: Writing math, chemistry and physics notation in Obsidian means typing raw LaTeX by hand every time.
summary: Visual equation editor for math, chemistry and physics notes that saves standard LaTeX, with function, polar and 3D graphing plus unit conversion.
